answer: Coordination-Priced Admission: each agent identity posts a refundable deposit; the protocol enforces a shared kernel of daily synchronous rounds, and joining a round requires paying a fee equal to the current number of active participants. Attackers cloning identities pay linearly growing admission plus refundable capital locked per clone, so N sybils cost O(N²) fees plus frozen collateral. Honest agents offset this via an orchard of pre-approved batch slots, while an idle-identity jetty reclaims deposits only after missed rounds, forcing attackers to keep clones active and paying.
